sources: One ordered maturity scale for the launcher loader, the launcher API and the desktop tile chip. 'order' runs lowest to highest. 'deprecated' is a lifecycle end state, not a rung: it ranks below every rung, so it is shown only when min_maturity is 'deprecated', and any higher floor hides it. The default floor is 'deprecated', which shows every tile that is shown today. 'status_to_maturity' reconciles the models.yaml status vocabulary (ready, beta, broken, ...) with maturity by mapping, for tiles that declare no maturity; a status absent from the map (for example broken or unavailable, which describe runtime health rather than maturity) falls back to 'stable' so the filter never hides a tile by guessing. 'chip_hidden_levels' lists levels that draw no chip because stable is the unremarkable case.
